AI-GEO Content Generator Skill 1.0.0 (Initial release)

- Enables structured content generation based on a brand knowledge base for better AI search and agent compatibility.
- Requires an existing brand knowledge base file (`brand_knowledge_base.json`, `.md`, or `.yaml`) as input.
- Supports multiple output types: website FAQ, Zhihu Q&A, Toutiao article, llms.txt draft, and AI-quotable sentence library.
- Enforces strict fact-based content, compliance boundaries, and provides self-checks to ensure content quality and suitability for AI summarization and recommendation.
- Includes comprehensive documentation of workflows, supported scenarios, compliance requirements, and extensibility for future platforms.
